hook_pattern: relatable surprise + verified statistic + simple plan
metaphor: rain of labelled surprise bills from a storm cloud; an umbrella labelled EMERGENCY FUND fills from $0 to $400 and shields one person

narration.script: A four hundred dollar surprise. A car repair. A doctor bill. More than one in three adults wouldn't cover it with cash. Build a small cushion. Ten dollars a week gets you there in forty weeks.

sources: Federal Reserve, Economic Well-Being of U.S. Households in 2025 (May 2026), executive summary and fact sheet: 63% of adults would cover a hypothetical $400 emergency expense with cash or its equivalent
disclosures: EXAMPLE $10/week x 40 weeks = $400, cash, no interest
audio: voice + subtle SFX, no music (creator adds music per platform)
